title: Gap Stitch: Scrub & Quickfix Register — Jun 2029
content:
Purpose: quick, scannable register for small coverage/ops gaps spotted in last two sprints. Not an incident log — ad-hoc fixes or 1-day mitigations to keep SLAs and feature rollouts stable. Use this during weekly ops huddle (Tue 10:30).

Legend: P1 = user-facing, immediate; P2 = degraded perf/observability; P3 = cosmetic/owner-time-window.

Table: id | short-title | owner | cross-teams | priority | snapshot-metric | quick-fix | est-hours | due | status
G-01 | region-fallback-noise | Liam Chen | serving-runtime, infra, s-reliability | P1 | 2.3% fallback-rate APAC peak (09:00-12:00) | bump fallback threshold + temporary route to eu-west | 3h | 2029-06-12 | done
G-02 | embeddings-cache-staleness | Mariana Gomez | observability, hosted-api | P2 | 14% stale-hit of recent uploads | invalidate prefix-cache for 3 buckets, add short-lived TTL | 2h | 2029-06-13 | in_progress
G-03 | rollout-flag-leak | Evan Brooks | console, platform-engineering | P2 | 1% rollout misapplied in canary cohort | force-rollout rollback for cohort B, audit flag-service logs | 4h | 2029-06-15 | open
G-04 | billing-metrics-gap | Aisha Patel | finance-and-legal, product-ops | P3 | missing per-route cost for dedicated GPU pool | add adhoc report query and send to finance daily | 1.5h | 2029-06-18 | open
G-05 | small-quant-payload-spike | Liam Chen | serving-runtime, optimize | P2 | 0.6 RPS spike when quantized variants served | short-circuit to unquantized variant above X tokens | 2h | 2029-06-16 | open
G-06 | docs-mismatch-sdk | Mariana Gomez | developer-experience | P3 | docs show old param name for stream API | update README and quickstart snippet; notify SDK release | 1h | 2029-06-14 | done

Notes & quick context:
- G-01: APAC fallback spike correlated with intermittent nvlink throttling on a single farm. Short-term: route + threshold. Medium-term: infra to schedule rolling reprovision.
- G-02: cache TTL misaligned after recent upload pipeline change (pipeline PR #4621). Observability will add a probe for stale ratio.
- G-03: suspected race in feature-flag persistence; repro steps in linked PR comments.
- G-05: quantized variant chosen by router for tokens>2048; regressions in memory pressure cause small RPS bump. Optimize team will evaluate kernel selection window.

Quick actions (owner pairing):
- Liam + SRE: implement region route patch and smoke test (G-01). Test window: 06/12 02:00-05:00 UTC.
- Mariana + Observability: add stale-hit alert (G-02) and backfill last 7 days for trendline.
- Evan + Console: run flag rollback and postmortem stub (G-03).

Mini metrics snapshot (for triage):
- Total register items: 6
- P1 items: 1
- Average est-hours: 2.1
- Open items: 3

Decision log (huddle 2029-06-12):
- Approve short-term fixes for G-01 and G-02. Owner to post status update in #ops-triage.
- G-03 rollback approved pending no-degradation test (Evan+QA). Rollback window set 06/15 04:00 UTC.

Unresolved questions / followups:
- Should we include a weighted impact score column? (pro: faster prioritization; con: noisy, subjective) => TODO decide next huddle.
- How frequently to prune done rows? Suggest weekly archive to archived/capacity-scrubs.

Edition notes:
- This is a living sheet; keep edits brief. If you take an item, mark status and add one-line update (who, what, when).
- When an ad-hoc fix becomes >8h of work, convert to normal Jira epic and remove from this register.

Contact: Aisha Patel (product-ops) — drop a note in #product-ops or ping on Slack if you need handoff.
